snippet.title: The Afterlife Cafe: A Visual Novel Game | Official Trailer #2
snippet.description:
The second trailer for the upcoming visual novel, The Afterlife Cafe.

Travel to the world of the dead, whose stories encourage reflection on life. Chat with spirits, brew drinks to suit your mood, and bond with the people who run the afterlife cafes.

In this urban sci-fi fantasy visual novel, your choices impact the living, the departed, and your own path forward.

DEMO OUT NOW!
Download the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763730/The_Afterlife_Cafe?utm_source=youtube
Play in browser on itch.io: https://guavapixelstudios.itch.io/afterlife-cafe-demo


Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763730/The_Afterlife_Cafe?utm_source=youtube
Studio website: https://guavapixelstudios.com
